app.title: TimeLimit Dashboard
overview.title: Overview
overview.empty: No children in this family yet.
banner.down: The server cannot be reached. You see the last known data; changes are disabled.
banner.not_configured: No server is set up yet. Choose a server in the settings.
error.SERVER_TIMEOUT: The server did not answer in time.
error.READ_ONLY_OFFLINE: The server is offline; changes are disabled.
settings.title: Settings
settings.debug.help: A text file with the settings and the end of the log, for support.
settings.debug.warning: The log can contain secrets when the log level is debug. Only share this file with someone you trust.
link.state.not_linked: Not linked yet. Log in with the mail address of a parent.
link.state.registered: The device is registered but not signed in as the parent Dashboard (it may have been signed out in the app). Enter the Dashboard password to sign in again.
link.state.ready: Linked. The dashboard acts as the parent Dashboard.
link.state.session_invalid: The server ended this session. Link again.
link.create_password: Password for the new parent Dashboard
link.help.join: The password is used once to create the parent Dashboard and is not stored.
link.help.create: This mail address has no family. On a test server a new family can be created.
link.help.no_family: This mail address has no family. Creating one is only possible when 'This is a test server' is on.
link.unlink.title: Unlink?
link.unlink.message: The link and the cached data of this server are removed. You have to link again.
notice.VERSION_UNTESTED: This server reports api level {level}, which is not tested (7, 9 and 10 are). The dashboard keeps working; check the results.
error.SESSION_INVALID: The server does not accept this link any more. Link again.
error.CONFLICT: The data changed meanwhile. Reload and try again.
error.ACTION_NOT_CONFIRMED: The server did not accept the change.
child.unknown.title: Child not found
child.unknown.text: This child is not known (any more).
child.gone: This child is no longer on the server. The data shown is the last known state.
child.devices.help: Read only. Devices on which this child is signed in.
child.device.name: Name
rules.no_categories: No categories yet, so there are no rules to set.
rules.window_help: Leave both empty for the whole day.
rules.extra_time: Extra time may be used on top
rules.none: No rules: no time limit applies in this category.
rules.delete.title: Delete this rule?
rules.delete.text: The rule is removed from the server.
rules.err.number: Enter a whole number from 0 to 1440.
rules.err.both_times: Enter both a start and an end time, or neither.
rules.err.both_session: Enter both a session length and a break, or neither.
rules.err.end_before_start: The end time must not be before the start time.
rules.not_today: This rule does not apply today.
rules.zone_warning: {child} is the child's time zone, but this dashboard runs in {dashboard}. "Off for today" follows the dashboard's day and midnight.
notice.RULE_RESTORED_LATE: A rule of {child} ({category}) was switched back on late, because the dashboard was not running at midnight.
notice.RULE_RESTORE_SKIPPED: A rule of {child} ({category}) that was off for today was changed or removed elsewhere, so it was left as it is.
notice.RULE_OFF_ENDED: The rule of {child} ({category}) is no longer off for today because you changed it.
rules.conflict.title: Changed in the meantime
rules.conflict.text: This rule was changed on the server after you opened it. Saving now overwrites that change.
notice.ITEMS_MISSING: {count} item(s) are no longer on the server. They are kept until you clean up.
blocked.help: Blocked times apply every week. Click or drag over the cells; each cell is 30 minutes.
blocked.no_categories: No categories yet, so there are no blocked times to set.
blocked.conflict.title: Changed in the meantime
blocked.conflict.text: The blocked times of this category were changed on the server after you opened them. Saving now overwrites that change.
blocked.discard.title: Discard changes?
blocked.discard: You have unsaved changes to the blocked times. Switching category discards them.
categories.name: Name
categories.add.title: New category
categories.edit.title: Edit category
categories.delete.title: Delete category?
categories.delete.has_subs: This category has sub-categories. Move or delete them first.
categories.limits.title: Switch limits off for a while
settings.warnings: Time warnings (minutes before the time is up)
settings.networks.block: Block this category on the saved networks
settings.networks.reset.title: Forget saved networks?
settings.networks.reset.text: All saved networks of this category are removed. They can only be saved again from the child's device.
settings.networks.help: Networks can only be saved from the child's device.
settings.invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to {max}.
categories.settings.title: Settings of {name}
apps.title: Apps of {name}
apps.unknown: The child's device has not reported its apps yet. Enter package names by hand.
apps.choose: Choose or enter at least one app.
test.title: Test section
test.intro: Only for a test server that no app is linked to. Adds family members straight on the server.
test.name: Name
test.database_note: Secrets are hidden. At most 200 rows per table.
time.title: Time for {name}
usage.limit_note: Allowed today is the strictest daily limit of the rules for today plus extra time. Time windows and sessions are not counted.
usage.history_note: The history is kept by this dashboard from its first use (at most 30 days) and starts again after a cache reset.
parents.title: Parents
parents.dashboard.ok: The dashboard is signed in as the parent Dashboard and stays signed in.
parents.dashboard.out: The device is not signed in as the parent Dashboard (for example because it was signed out in the app). Enter the Dashboard password under Link to the family to sign in again.
parents.change.title: Change the password of {name}
parents.change.help: The password is only used for this change and is not stored.
parents.change.mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same.
audit.empty: No changes made through the dashboard yet.
audit.note: Changes made through this dashboard, kept for 30 days.
audit.general.help: Changes that belong to no child, such as password changes. Kept for 30 days.
audit.action.SET_DEVICE_USER: Device signed in as a user
childlimits.title: Switch all limits off for a while
childlimits.help: Every time limit of this child is ignored until the chosen moment. Blocked times and temporary blocks stay as they are.
apps.remove.title: Remove apps?
apps.remove.text: Remove {count} app(s) from "{category}"? They are no longer limited by this category.
